vehicle.label: Toyota Fortuner
vehicle.safe_water_basis: 50% of published wading depth (700 mm, still water, 7 km/h) (Australian diesel Fortuner reference; Vietnamese petrol variant unverified)
vehicle.assumptions: L/W/H/wheelbase/ground clearance from Toyota VN (API https://www.toyota.com.vn/api/carDetail/BigGroupDetail?bigGroupId=1070&modelId=319&gradeId=534). Toyota VN does NOT publish turning radius for Fortuner: 5.8 m = half of 11.6 m turning circle published by Toyota Australia (spec sheet says 'kerb to kerb' https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/fortuner/files/20231201_fortuner_spec-sheet-v2.pdf ; 2020 press release says '(tyre)'). Wading depth 700 mm and track 1540/1555 are Toyota Australia figures for the same-generation (2020 facelift) 2.8 diesel Fortuner (press release 13-08-2020 https://pressroom.toyota.com.au/PressRelease?pr-code=49399769-f533-4871-8a2a-b649da04676e ; also approach 29 deg, departure 25 deg, ramp-over 23.5 deg, running clearance 216 mm); not published for the VN petrol variant. VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)

vehicle.label: Toyota Fortuner
vehicle.safe_water_basis: 50% of published wading depth (700 mm, still water, 7 km/h) (Australian diesel Fortuner reference; Vietnamese petrol variant unverified)
vehicle.assumptions: L/W/H/wheelbase/ground clearance from Toyota VN (API https://www.toyota.com.vn/api/carDetail/BigGroupDetail?bigGroupId=1070&modelId=319&gradeId=534). Toyota VN does NOT publish turning radius for Fortuner: 5.8 m = half of 11.6 m turning circle published by Toyota Australia (spec sheet says 'kerb to kerb' https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/fortuner/files/20231201_fortuner_spec-sheet-v2.pdf ; 2020 press release says '(tyre)'). Wading depth 700 mm and track 1540/1555 are Toyota Australia figures for the same-generation (2020 facelift) 2.8 diesel Fortuner (press release 13-08-2020 https://pressroom.toyota.com.au/PressRelease?pr-code=49399769-f533-4871-8a2a-b649da04676e ; also approach 29 deg, departure 25 deg, ramp-over 23.5 deg, running clearance 216 mm); not published for the VN petrol variant. VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)

Toyota VN does NOT publish turning radius for Fortuner: 5.8 m = half of 11.6 m turning circle published by Toyota Australia (spec sheet says 'kerb to kerb' https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/fortuner/files/20231201_fortuner_spec-sheet-v2.pdf ; 2020 press release says '(tyre)'). Wading depth 700 mm and track 1540/1555 are Toyota Australia figures for the same-generation (2020 facelift) 2.8 diesel Fortuner (press release 13-08-2020 https://pressroom.toyota.com.au/PressRelease?pr-code=49399769-f533-4871-8a2a-b649da04676e ; also approach 29 deg, departure 25 deg, ramp-over 23.5 deg, running clearance 216 mm); not published for the VN petrol variant. VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)

VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. vehicle.safe_water_basis: 50% of published wading depth (700 mm, still water, 7 km/h) (Australian diesel Fortuner reference; Vietnamese petrol variant unverified)
vehicle.assumptions: L/W/H/wheelbase/ground clearance from Toyota VN (API https://www.toyota.com.vn/api/carDetail/BigGroupDetail?bigGroupId=1070&modelId=319&gradeId=534). Toyota VN does NOT publish turning radius for Fortuner: 5.8 m = half of 11.6 m turning circle published by Toyota Australia (spec sheet says 'kerb to kerb' https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/fortuner/files/20231201_fortuner_spec-sheet-v2.pdf ; 2020 press release says '(tyre)'). Wading depth 700 mm and track 1540/1555 are Toyota Australia figures for the same-generation (2020 facelift) 2.8 diesel Fortuner (press release 13-08-2020 https://pressroom.toyota.com.au/PressRelease?pr-code=49399769-f533-4871-8a2a-b649da04676e ; also approach 29 deg, departure 25 deg, ramp-over 23.5 deg, running clearance 216 mm); not published for the VN petrol variant. VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)

vehicle.safe_water_basis: 50% of published wading depth (700 mm, still water, 7 km/h) (Australian diesel Fortuner reference; Vietnamese petrol variant unverified)
vehicle.assumptions: L/W/H/wheelbase/ground clearance from Toyota VN (API https://www.toyota.com.vn/api/carDetail/BigGroupDetail?bigGroupId=1070&modelId=319&gradeId=534). Toyota VN does NOT publish turning radius for Fortuner: 5.8 m = half of 11.6 m turning circle published by Toyota Australia (spec sheet says 'kerb to kerb' https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/fortuner/files/20231201_fortuner_spec-sheet-v2.pdf ; 2020 press release says '(tyre)'). Wading depth 700 mm and track 1540/1555 are Toyota Australia figures for the same-generation (2020 facelift) 2.8 diesel Fortuner (press release 13-08-2020 https://pressroom.toyota.com.au/PressRelease?pr-code=49399769-f533-4871-8a2a-b649da04676e ; also approach 29 deg, departure 25 deg, ramp-over 23.5 deg, running clearance 216 mm); not published for the VN petrol variant. VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)

VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)

vehicle.assumptions: L/W/H/wheelbase/ground clearance from Toyota VN (API https://www.toyota.com.vn/api/carDetail/BigGroupDetail?bigGroupId=1070&modelId=319&gradeId=534). Toyota VN does NOT publish turning radius for Fortuner: 5.8 m = half of 11.6 m turning circle published by Toyota Australia (spec sheet says 'kerb to kerb' https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/fortuner/files/20231201_fortuner_spec-sheet-v2.pdf ; 2020 press release says '(tyre)'). Wading depth 700 mm and track 1540/1555 are Toyota Australia figures for the same-generation (2020 facelift) 2.8 diesel Fortuner (press release 13-08-2020 https://pressroom.toyota.com.au/PressRelease?pr-code=49399769-f533-4871-8a2a-b649da04676e ; also approach 29 deg, departure 25 deg, ramp-over 23.5 deg, running clearance 216 mm); not published for the VN petrol variant. VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)

vehicle.safe_water_basis: 50% of published wading depth (700 mm, still water, 7 km/h) (Australian diesel Fortuner reference; Vietnamese petrol variant unverified)
vehicle.assumptions: L/W/H/wheelbase/ground clearance from Toyota VN (API https://www.toyota.com.vn/api/carDetail/BigGroupDetail?bigGroupId=1070&modelId=319&gradeId=534). Toyota VN does NOT publish turning radius for Fortuner: 5.8 m = half of 11.6 m turning circle published by Toyota Australia (spec sheet says 'kerb to kerb' https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/fortuner/files/20231201_fortuner_spec-sheet-v2.pdf ; 2020 press release says '(tyre)'). Wading depth 700 mm and track 1540/1555 are Toyota Australia figures for the same-generation (2020 facelift) 2.8 diesel Fortuner (press release 13-08-2020 https://pressroom.toyota.com.au/PressRelease?pr-code=49399769-f533-4871-8a2a-b649da04676e ; also approach 29 deg, departure 25 deg, ramp-over 23.5 deg, running clearance 216 mm); not published for the VN petrol variant. VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)

vehicle.label: Toyota Fortuner
vehicle.safe_water_basis: 50% of published wading depth (700 mm, still water, 7 km/h) (Australian diesel Fortuner reference; Vietnamese petrol variant unverified)
vehicle.assumptions: L/W/H/wheelbase/ground clearance from Toyota VN (API https://www.toyota.com.vn/api/carDetail/BigGroupDetail?bigGroupId=1070&modelId=319&gradeId=534). Toyota VN does NOT publish turning radius for Fortuner: 5.8 m = half of 11.6 m turning circle published by Toyota Australia (spec sheet says 'kerb to kerb' https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/fortuner/files/20231201_fortuner_spec-sheet-v2.pdf ; 2020 press release says '(tyre)'). Wading depth 700 mm and track 1540/1555 are Toyota Australia figures for the same-generation (2020 facelift) 2.8 diesel Fortuner (press release 13-08-2020 https://pressroom.toyota.com.au/PressRelease?pr-code=49399769-f533-4871-8a2a-b649da04676e ; also approach 29 deg, departure 25 deg, ramp-over 23.5 deg, running clearance 216 mm); not published for the VN petrol variant. VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)

vehicle.safe_water_basis: 50% of published wading depth (700 mm, still water, 7 km/h) (Australian diesel Fortuner reference; Vietnamese petrol variant unverified)
vehicle.assumptions: L/W/H/wheelbase/ground clearance from Toyota VN (API https://www.toyota.com.vn/api/carDetail/BigGroupDetail?bigGroupId=1070&modelId=319&gradeId=534). Toyota VN does NOT publish turning radius for Fortuner: 5.8 m = half of 11.6 m turning circle published by Toyota Australia (spec sheet says 'kerb to kerb' https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/fortuner/files/20231201_fortuner_spec-sheet-v2.pdf ; 2020 press release says '(tyre)'). Wading depth 700 mm and track 1540/1555 are Toyota Australia figures for the same-generation (2020 facelift) 2.8 diesel Fortuner (press release 13-08-2020 https://pressroom.toyota.com.au/PressRelease?pr-code=49399769-f533-4871-8a2a-b649da04676e ; also approach 29 deg, departure 25 deg, ramp-over 23.5 deg, running clearance 216 mm); not published for the VN petrol variant. VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)

vehicle.safe_water_basis: 50% of published wading depth (700 mm, still water, 7 km/h) (Australian diesel Fortuner reference; Vietnamese petrol variant unverified)
vehicle.assumptions: L/W/H/wheelbase/ground clearance from Toyota VN (API https://www.toyota.com.vn/api/carDetail/BigGroupDetail?bigGroupId=1070&modelId=319&gradeId=534). Toyota VN does NOT publish turning radius for Fortuner: 5.8 m = half of 11.6 m turning circle published by Toyota Australia (spec sheet says 'kerb to kerb' https://www.toyota.com.au/-/media/toyota/main-site/vehicle-hubs/fortuner/files/20231201_fortuner_spec-sheet-v2.pdf ; 2020 press release says '(tyre)'). Wading depth 700 mm and track 1540/1555 are Toyota Australia figures for the same-generation (2020 facelift) 2.8 diesel Fortuner (press release 13-08-2020 https://pressroom.toyota.com.au/PressRelease?pr-code=49399769-f533-4871-8a2a-b649da04676e ; also approach 29 deg, departure 25 deg, ramp-over 23.5 deg, running clearance 216 mm); not published for the VN petrol variant. VN ground clearance 279 mm vs Toyota AU running clearance 216 mm: large gap, measurement basis not stated. A new lower grade 'FORTUNER 2.7AT 4x2' (265/65R17) is listed on toyota.com.vn with dimensions 'Chưa có thông tin' (not yet available)
